purpose: An RTT-ready module defining operators, regimes, layers, and transitions for RTT analysis.

operators.name: shift
operators.description: Move the frame of reference forward or backward.
operators.example: Shift one step forward to reveal the next state.

operators.name: hold
operators.description: Stabilize the current frame for analysis.
operators.example: Hold the moment to inspect the transition.

operators.name: compare
operators.description: Contrast two states to reveal change.
operators.example: Compare the current state to the previous one.

regimes.name: transitional
regimes.description: The system is shifting between patterns.

regimes.name: divergent
regimes.description: The system breaks from its previous pattern.

layers.name: structural
layers.description: The underlying rules shaping the surface.

layers.name: resonance
layers.description: The deep tendencies that persist across changes.

rules: A shift operator may trigger a regime change.
A hold operator stabilizes the current layer.
A compare operator reveals divergence or coherence.

meta.notes: RTT-ready module template defining operators, regimes, layers, and transitions.
